title: Intermediate server intermediating federated learning, user device, and system including intermediate server and user device

pse.problem: Inefficiency in updating a global model in federated learning due to reliance on a central server for model updates and potential single point of failure.
pse.solution_function: The intermediate server receives a global model from a central server, transmits it to user devices, updates the global model based on local models received from the user devices, and issues certificates to the central server. User devices receive the global model, generate local models by training the global model using individual data, encrypt or decrypt the global model and individual data based on a key manager in the machine learning core, and transmit the generated local model to the intermediate server.
pse.solution_structure: The intermediate server consists of memory and at least one processor. User devices consist of memory, at least one processor, and optionally a machine learning core. A root server issues certificates with key pairs for signing and encryption.
pse.solution_implementation: The intermediate server executes instructions causing it to perform the described functions. User devices execute instructions causing them to generate local models, encrypt or decrypt data based on the key manager, and transmit local models. The system control logic involves the exchange of global and local models between the intermediate server and user devices.
pse.effect: Improved scalability, resilience, and security in federated learning by reducing dependency on a central server, improving model updates through multiple data sources, and adding an additional layer of security through certificates.
